Subject: EU data localization MAP — stakeholder roll call & evaluation schedule

Hi Sophie, Luca, and team —

Thanks again for agreeing to run through a mutual action plan (MAP) focused on EU data localization and cross-border considerations. To keep momentum, I’ve attached a first-pass MAP draft that pairs required deliverables with proposed owners and target dates.

Quick context: this MAP is scoped to support a production evaluation (demo + security questionnaire review + residency confirmation) ahead of your procurement committee decision targeted for end of Q4. The goal of this kickoff is to align on stakeholders, establish an evaluation cadence, and lock the close timeline.

Ask 1 — Roles: please confirm who on the Euratek side will own the following:
- Legal / Contract signoff
- Security / SOC2 + questionnaire owners
- Infrastructure / networking (VPC, VPN, IP allowlists)
- Data residency lead (PO or Compliance)

Ask 2 — Timeline constraints: are there any internal freeze dates or holidays (particularly EU office closures) we should avoid for live testing or on-site work?

Ask 3 — Evaluation inputs: we propose the following tentative schedule — please confirm or propose changes:
- Week of Nov 16: Security questionnaire review (exchange answers, follow-ups)
- Nov 18: Technical demo + prefix/KV cache walkthrough (30–45m)
- Week of Nov 23: Residency validation window (logs, routing checks)
- Nov 30: Joint review & final recommendations to procurement

Attachments: MAP-draft-Redwood-Euratek-Nov2026.pdf (attached) — master MAP with deliverables; evaluation-checklist.csv (attached) — lightweight checklist for test owners.

We’ll own scheduling the demo and prepping the evaluation checklist. Jonas will be Redwood’s technical lead, Marissa will run compliance coordination, and I’ll manage the MAP timeline and contracting touchpoints.

Looking forward — I’ll hold a short 30-minute sync (calendar invite to follow) after we confirm roles.

Best,

Priyom Das
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the clear plan and the MAP draft. Quick roll call from our side:
- Contracts / Legal: Claudia Neumann (legal@euratek.com) — primary owner for T&Cs and DPAs
- Security / Compliance: Tomasz Kowalczyk (secops@euratek.com) — will lead questionnaire review, SOC2 gaps
- Infrastructure / Network: Anja Becker (network@euratek.com) — VPC peering and firewall rules
- Data Residency Owner: Sophie Müller (myself) — overall program lead for residency validation and regulatory checks

Timeline notes: procurement has a hard gating review the week of Dec 7, so the Nov 30 joint review you propose would be ideal; if anything slips we risk pushing a decision out to January. Also, we have an internal lock on Nov 25–27 for company-wide maintenance (limited access), so avoid scheduling critical tests those days.

I’ve attached our completed security questionnaire (Euratek-Security-Questionnaire-answers.xlsx) — it’s not exhaustive but should help the first pass. Tomasz will follow up with any clarifying questions.

We can do the demo on Nov 18 at 10:00 CET; that works for our engineering and compliance leads. Confirm and send an invite.

Best regards,
